titel: I Want More Than A Hug

audio.user_agent: AppleCoreMedia/1.0.0.21F79 (iPhone; U; CPU OS 17_5 like Mac OS X)

einzeiler: 关于拥抱、情感连接与渴望深层陪伴的思考。
kurzfassung: 本期节目围绕人类对情感连接和深度拥抱的渴望展开。歌词中穿插着对现实的思考以及对未来陪伴的期盼。对话探讨了不希望被离开、追求超越普通拥抱的情感诉求。
stichpunkte: 探讨了面对现实时的心境变化
表达了对伴侣靠近与倾听的渴望
呼唤内心的真实感受与另一个世界的存在
强调了紧密拥抱对情感连接的重要性
承诺彼此不会离开对方
坦言想要的远不止是一个简单的拥抱

kapitel.titel: 寻找现实与内心的连接

clips.text: When I Hit You Baby Oh Baby Dummy
What's In Your Mind Baby If You Want To Hold On
So Why Don't You Come To Me Oh Baby Kiss Me

clips.hook: 想要的远不止是一个拥抱
clips.text: You Will Never Never Hug Me You Don't Know I Want More Than A Hug So Deeply Hug Me

beschreibung:
I Want More Than A Hug
作曲。Jessie LI
作詞。Athéna YIN

When I hear you baby...
With a heart of lady...
In the magic evening...
But these happened lately...
You were saying: hug me...

How dare you love me...

Oh baby...
THE ME...

Paris turned rainy...
Think about the reality...
What's in your mind baby?
If you want to hold me...
There is another world to see...
(so) Why don't you come to me...

Oh baby...
KISS ME...

Want you come to me...

Deeply hug me...
Everything disappears but you and me...

Promise you will never never leave me...
Promise you will never never lie to me...
You don't know I want more than a hug...
(so) Deeply hug me...
